name: dragon
description: Kill the ender dragon in the End. Needs a world whose End still has its dragon: a /summon'ed ender_dragon has no EnderDragonFight controller and just hovers. The fixture gives gear, a real fight and a recoverable respawn; it does NOT clear the crystals, remove the endermen, place the bot in the right spot or tell it the tactics - that is the rung.
goal:
You are in the End. Kill the ender dragon, then say 'dragon dead'.
You have a bow and arrows, a diamond sword, diamond armour, a carved pumpkin, food, golden apples, blocks and ender pearls. The standard library has `lib/dragon` (shoot_crystals, fight_dragon) and `lib/combat` (kit_up, eat_if_hurt, lead_shot, back_off, hold_ground), and there is an optional `dragon_fight` reflex you can switch on with reflex_set if you want the body fighting between your turns. Whether and how you use any of that is your call.
One hard rule, because it is unrecoverable rather than tactical: never dig down here - below the island is the void.

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run forceload add -32 -32 32 32
